title: [GMCP 203.020.01] Contract: GMCP server authoring SDK and plugin lifecycle
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-020-01. Translate the mastery target into a normative clause and behavior table. Pin source revisions and hashes; define canonical APIs and data models, compatibility and deprecation decisions, threat model, measurable SLO or resource budgets, positive and negative fixtures, and immutable evidence locations. Resolve every ambiguity before implementation. Vector outcome: A stable Susi-shaped authoring SDK builds local MCP servers, tools, resources, prompts, subscriptions, MRTR handlers, tasks and extensions with schema derivation, typed context, middleware, testing fixtures and hot reload. Plugins declare permissions and compatibility, initialize transactionally, unload without leaks, preserve no vendor types across the boundary, and ship runnable minimal through production examples. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
